description: The continuous intent-satisfaction METER: check a brief's intent JSON (per /intent.schema.json) against a plan and report how much it satisfies. Returns { ok, satisfied, total, score, subscores, violations } where `score` is satisfied/total in [0,1] (an empty intent scores 1). It MEASURES, it never gates — so you can watch a plan approach the brief across edits. A malformed intent returns `{ ok:false, intentErrors }` (data, never a throw).

brief.description: A brief's intent JSON (per /intent.schema.json) to measure against.

name: score
title: Score a plan against a brief (intent meter)
